# Bambu

## Takeaway

Bambu performs context-aware transcript discovery and quantification from long-read RNA-seq alignments, including known and novel transcript evidence.

## Input and output

- Input: aligned BAM files, transcript annotation and reference genome FASTA.
- Output: transcript and gene count matrices, discovered transcript models and QC.
- Record: genome/annotation release, aligner, strandedness and filtering thresholds.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01908-w
- Code: https://github.com/GoekeLab/bambu
- Pipeline companion: https://github.com/GoekeLab/bambu-pipe
- Turnkey entry: R/03_bambu_long_read.R.

## Limitation

Transcript discovery is sensitive to alignment and reference preparation. Keep known and novel transcript calls separate when interpreting biological claims.
